title: Eiffel Tower Chief Resigns After Female Staff Moved for Hindu Group’s Visit
summary_full: Patrick Branco Ruivo, who ran the tower’s operating company, will step down after an internal inquiry cited “problems and shortcomings” over the moving of female employees.
